name_note: The GTDB name Clostridium_A leptum refers to the organism published as Clostridium leptum, which NCBI lists as [Clostridium] leptum.

sentences.text: Clostridium leptum is described as a human gut microbe.
An X-ray structure was solved for its carboxyspermidine decarboxylase, the enzyme performing the terminal step of spermidine production in 70 percent of human gut microbes.
A pilot study of 20 rheumatoid arthritis patients and 30 controls reported decreased Clostridium leptum in stool samples from the patients.
The same report states that low Clostridium leptum levels are a risk factor for the development of asthma.
